releaseNotes:
- Fixed in-product Core upgrades so the restarted service resolves its version
  from the active installed release instead of retaining a stale version value
  from the previous supervisor process
- Updated the AgentOS supervisor to reload the current release manifest before
  every managed service restart, keeping health, update status, and program
  directory information consistent after an upgrade
- Unified all settings progress indicators with the shared neutral system
  palette while preserving red exclusively for failed progress states
- Kept AgentOS Runtime `1.0.0-beta.3` unchanged so this Core-only update does
  not republish or redownload Runtime artifacts

### Verification

- Passed the complete 269-test TypeScript, Server, UI, and TypeScript SDK suite
  after a production build
- Passed all 10 Java 8 SDK tests and built the `2.0.0-beta.13` SDK JAR
- Passed the Sandbox VMM Go test suite
- Verified the installed beta.12 service reports a consistent version and
  program directory after a managed restart
- Verified the updated settings progress palette on the real System settings
  route in both light and dark themes
- Assembled and signature-verified the macOS arm64 Core archive, packaged the
  offline installer with unchanged AgentOS Runtime `1.0.0-beta.3`, and verified
  a fresh beta.13 installation and System settings route in an isolated prefix
